svg.aria-label: Adductor group: origins and insertions — 内收肌群：起点与止点

text.aria-label: Adductor group: origins and insertions — 内收肌群：起点与止点
Superficial layer — 浅层
Deep layer — 深层
Origin area — 起点区
Insertion area — 止点区
Origin → insertion — 起点 → 止点
Pectineus — 耻骨肌
Origin: pecten of superior pubic ramus — 起点：耻骨上支耻骨梳
text.tspan: Origin: pecten of superior pubic ramus

text.aria-label: Insertion: pectineal line of femur — 止点：股骨耻骨肌线
Adductor longus — 长收肌
Origin: body of pubis — 起点：耻骨体
Insertion: middle third of linea aspera — 止点：股骨粗线中 1/3
text.tspan: Insertion: middle third of linea aspera

text.aria-label: Gracilis — 股薄肌
Origin: body and inferior ramus of pubis — 起点：耻骨体和耻骨下支
text.tspan: Origin: body and inferior ramus of pubis
起点：耻骨体和耻骨下支

text.aria-label: Insertion: pes anserinus — 止点：鹅足
Adductor brevis — 短收肌
Origin: body and inferior ramus of pubis — 起点：耻骨体和耻骨下支
text.tspan: Origin: body and inferior ramus of pubis
起点：耻骨体和耻骨下支

text.aria-label: Insertion: upper linea aspera — 止点：股骨粗线上部
Adductor magnus — 大收肌
Origin: ischiopubic ramus, ischial tuberosity — 起点：坐耻骨支、坐骨结节
text.tspan: 起点：坐耻骨支、坐骨结节

text.aria-label: Insertion: linea aspera, adductor tubercle — 止点：股骨粗线、收肌结节
text.tspan: 止点：股骨粗线、收肌结节
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
